from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-low-fresh0/frozen/held-out-reference/play/users/u003/system/state/workspace/programs/task-c6895f54.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    # Reconstruct the inner colored board and rotate its pattern.
    r0=next(r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if 1 in row)
    r1=max(r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if 1 in row)
    c0=min(c for row in grid for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==1)
    c1=max(c for row in grid for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==1)
    a=[row[c0:c1+1] for row in grid[r0:r1+1]]
    h,w=len(a),len(a[0])
    out=[[1]*w for _ in range(h+2)]
    # Rotate colored motif 90 degrees clockwise within the canvas.
    for r in range(h):
      for c in range(w):
        if a[r][c] not in (0,1):
          rr=c%(h); cc=w-1-r
          out[rr+1][cc]=a[r][c]
    # place the outside markers in the added border
    marks=[(r,c,v) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v not in (0,1) and not (r0<=r<=r1 and c0<=c<=c1)]
    for i,(r,c,v) in enumerate(marks):
      rr=0 if r<r0 else h+1
      cc=max(0,min(w-1,round((c-c0)*w/max(1,c1-c0))))
      out[rr][cc]=v
    return out
'''
